cases.input: Two runs pin one design but different dataset snapshots and random seeds; one supports and one challenges the hypothesis.
cases.expect: Both manifests and outcomes remain distinct and the hypothesis revision is unchanged.
Both attempts remain append-only with retry lineage and separate evidence.

cases.input: A hypothesis revision is edited after result access to match observations.
cases.expect: Rejected; create an explicit post-hoc or successor hypothesis revision externally.

cases.input: A failed experiment is deleted after a successful rerun.
cases.expect: Rejected; failed run remains retained and citable.

cases.input: No observation exists for one outcome.
cases.expect: Run records missingness or coverage; it never asserts zero or no effect.

cases.input: Executed sample size and environment differ from the design.
cases.expect: Two typed deviations record planned and executed values with authority and evidence.

cases.input: One input dataset is more restricted than the run summary.
cases.expect: Run and derived result access retain the stricter evidence ceiling.
